objects: Natural node count J; positive real interval length h; nodes t_i; real Lagrange polynomials ell_j; their absolute-sum function and interval supremum Lambda; integrated second-order coefficients omega_ij; integrated first-order weights v_j, denoting momentumWeight; Kronecker node values and finite sums.
domains: J in N with J>=2; h in R with h>0; indices i,j,k in Fin(J). t:Fin(J)->R; ell:Fin(J)->R[X]; Lambda in R; omega:Fin(J)->Fin(J)->R; v:Fin(J)->R. The supremum is over the real closed interval [0,h]; the partition-of-unity conclusion is over all s in R. All integrals use real Lebesgue interval integration.
quantifiers: For every natural J>=2 and every real h>0, with t,ell,Lambda,omega,v fixed by the exact definitions, the displayed conjunction holds. Node membership and both absolute-row bounds hold for every i; Lagrange nodal equality for every i,j; partition of unity for every real s. Injectivity is global on Fin(J). Last-node equality, Lambda lower bound and total momentum-weight equality are unconditional conclusions for the fixed J,h. No existentially selected coefficient array occurs.
assumptions: Only J>=2 and h>0. The nodes, Lagrange product, supremum and integral coefficients are defined by the displayed formulas, rather than assumed arbitrary. J-1 in the real-annotated quotient is real subtraction after coercion. No extra distinctness, positivity of weights, maximum bound or quadrature hypothesis is assumed; distinctness is concluded. Approved definitions specify polynomial evaluation, real supremum and oriented Lebesgue interval integral.
conclusion: All nodes lie in [0,h], t is injective, the last node equals h, ell_i(t_j) is the Kronecker delta, sum_j ell_j(s)=1 for every real s, and Lambda>=1. For every row i, its coefficient absolute sum is bounded both by t_i^2 Lambda/2 and by h^2 Lambda/2. The signed sum of momentum weights equals h. Exact coefficient formulas and scopes are in reconstructed_theorem_text.
scopes: Interpolation equality concerns all pairs of actual nodes; partition of unity concerns the entire real line. Lambda controls the absolute-sum function over [0,h]; only its lower bound is explicitly concluded, with no quantitative upper growth law. Row bounds concern sums of absolute values, whereas the momentum-weight normalization is a signed sum. The theorem does not assert positivity of individual weights, additional position-weight moment identities, or general quadrature exactness. No material ambiguity is present.
constant_dependencies: t_i=(h/2)(1-cos((i/(J-1))pi)); ell_j is the exact Lagrange basis for these nodes; Lambda is their [0,h] absolute-sum supremum. omega_ij integrates (t_i-s)ell_j(s) from 0 to t_i; v_j integrates ell_j(s) from 0 to h. Exact bounds are (t_i)^2 Lambda/2 and h^2 Lambda/2. The normalization is exactly h and Lambda lower bound exactly 1. All coefficients are fixed by J,h.
